script_text: Pisces, the cosmos is about to rearrange your emotional landscape this week. Sunday's Sun-Venus sextile in your 4th House soothes domestic life, but Monday's Moon square Saturn in your 1st House forces a boundary conversation you've been avoiding. Tuesday brings Mars trine Jupiter energy, sharpening your professional ambition. Wednesday marks the major shift as Mercury enters your 10th House of career, forming a transformative trine to Neptune, your ruling planet, opening doors to significant breakthroughs. Thursday through Saturday, Venus glides into your 5th House of love, sparking unexpected romance and creative inspiration. The weekend Sun in Libra opposes your natal Mars, creating real tension in key relationships. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Neptune in your 10th House. Sunday is your warning day as Saturn's pressure mounts. As a water sign, trust your deep intuition — it knows before you do. Follow for daily updates.
